entities.summary: Markos Kyprianou is a Cypriot politician who served as Minister of Foreign Affairs until his official resignation on 19 July 2011, following the events of the Evangelos Florakis Naval Base explosion. A member of the Democratic Party, he was previously Cyprus's Minister of Finance from 2003 to 2004 and a European Commissioner from 2004 to 2008. He tendered his resignation as Commissioner on 29 February 2008 to become Foreign Minister in the government of President Dimitris Christofias; the resignation took effect on 3 March 2008, when his successor, Androulla Vassiliou, was confirmed as Commissioner.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Markos Kyprianou's tenure as Minister of Foreign Affairs was marked by his resignation following the Evangelos Florakis Naval Base explosion, a significant event in Cyprus' history. His previous roles as European Commissioner and Minister of Finance demonstrate his impact on regional politics.
